title: NullPointerException in WorkbenchPage.busyShowView when part reference is already disposed
description: Closing a dynamic editor while an async UI job attempts to reveal an associated perspective view causes busyShowView to dereference a null part pointer, throwing NPE in org.eclipse.ui.internal.WorkbenchPage.java:1289.
fix_patch_summary: Added defensive check `if (ref == null || ref.getPart(false) == null) return;` before delegating view activation to PartPane.

title: Database metadata catalog lookup deadlock in Data Tools Platform (DTP) connection thread
description: Connecting to PostgreSQL database via DTP driver causes UI freeze. Connection worker thread acquires ConnectionProfile lock while background schema reader holds CatalogLoader monitor, creating fatal AB-BA thread deadlock.
fix_patch_summary: Unified synchronization lock acquisition order across ConnectionProfile and CatalogLoader using ReentrantLock with 10s timeout.

title: OutOfMemoryError in JDT Java index manager when indexing Maven multi-module target folders
description: JavaModelManager IndexManager creates excessive JarFileIndex references without releasing file descriptors when indexing large target/classes directories, causing heap exhaustion and crash.
fix_patch_summary: Enhanced index cache eviction policy to purge closed project index buffers and exclude generated build output dirs from continuous indexing.

title: OAuth2 / JWT Token expiration in Eclipse Marketplace Client results in silent login failure
description: When an MPC session token expires after 1 hour, refreshing marketplace catalogs fails silently without prompting re-authentication or refreshing the Bearer token in secure storage.
fix_patch_summary: Intercept 401 HTTP responses in MarketplaceHttpClient, invalidate stored token, and trigger interactive re-login dialog with token refresh callback.

title: P2 repository download timeout during slow network updates leaves repository in locked state
description: ECF transport times out after 30 seconds of packet silence during artifact jar mirror download, but file lock on artifacts.xml is not released, preventing subsequent install retries.
fix_patch_summary: Added resource cleanup in finally block of FileReader.runProcessor and introduced configurable socket read timeout with resume capability.
